blurb: Freewheeling Adventures offers small group and self-guided bike tours, walking tours, and hiking holidays with attentive vehicle support and quality rental bikes. Tours range from easy to very challenging and cover various international and Canadian destinations. Groups are small, usually no more than 12 people, with a guide to guest ratio of about 1:6 or better.
